_comment: The FHIR core packages the translation-supplement check compiles against, one per fhirVersion an IG's sushi-config.yaml may name. Each is fetched from the registry.npmjs.org mirror of the FHIR package registry (published by the trusted npm account fhir-cache-seed-npm.ts names), checked against the sha512 here before it is unpacked into the FHIR package cache, so SUSHI resolves no FHIR package at run time. The check compiles only the IG's CodeSystems and their supplements, so no IG dependency is needed. A fhirVersion not listed here is refused, not fetched.
